faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Kaimur Support Person recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the DCPU Kaimur Support Person recruitment is 26th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies announced for the Support Person position by the District Child Protection Unit Kaimur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Support Person role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Social Work (MSW), Sociology, Psychology, Child Development, or Law, or a Graduate degree with a Diploma in Child Rights/Counseling, along with 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Support Person post is between 30 years (minimum) and 65 years (maximum) as of 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Support Person position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Support Person role is Rs. 9000 per case. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DCPU Kaimur Support Person recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an evaluation of applications followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for DCPU Kaimur?
faq.answer: The official website for the District Child Protection Unit Kaimur is https://kaimur.nic.in. Candidates can visit this site for the application form and further details.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity offered by the District Child Protection Unit Kaimur for the Support Person position.
